title: Update creation output to show type and shortest unambiguous ID
description:
Change creation output format from '✓ Created issue {short_id}' to 'Created {full_type} {appropriate_length_id}'.

Implement 'appropriate length ID' as a global concept:
- Minimum-length prefix of UUID that is both unambiguous AND ≥3 characters
- Always lowercase
- Define once in SPEC.md (authoritative reference)
- Implement once as function (e.g., Operations::appropriate_length_id())

Changes needed:
1. Add appropriate_length_id() function in operations.rs
2. Define concept in SPEC.md
3. Update main.rs creation output to use full type and appropriate length ID
4. Update README to clarify shorthand notation (ux is shorthand for ux_problem) and document ≥3 character ID requirement
5. Ensure all ID acceptance is lowercase only
6. Update tests to verify new format
